# AI Threat Watch

> A world map and verified case files of publicly reported AI security incidents: attacks on AI systems (prompt injection, model and data leaks, AI supply chain, agent hijacks) and attacks carried out with AI (deepfake fraud, AI-assisted malware, AI phishing, state operations). A live wire of AI security news from vetted sources is refreshed every 30 minutes; verified case files are researched separately and carry a permanent link, primary sources and a citation. Case files are available in English, French, Spanish, Arabic, Chinese and Russian. All data is open under CC BY 4.0.

Positioning: a reference registry of AI security incidents (attacks on AI systems, and attacks carried out with AI): structured, verified, fast, multilingual and openly licensed.

## Key pages
- [All verified case files](https://aithreat.io/cases/): 356 incidents, newest first, with hubs by type and country
- [Interactive world map](https://aithreat.io/): the same cases on a map with filters
- [Live wire](https://aithreat.io/#wire): AI security headlines from vetted sources, refreshed every 30 minutes (machine-triaged, not verified)
- [Data and citing](https://aithreat.io/#data): download links, field list, inclusion rule, severity scale
- [Patterns and statistics](https://aithreat.io/patterns/): trends recomputed each update from the verified case files: cases per quarter by direction (on AI vs with AI), category heat map, attacks by autonomous AI agents, actor types by year, severity mix, documented losses by category, victim sectors, countries, status and verification speed, wire volume by kind; numbers as JSON at https://aithreat.io/data/stats.json
- [Research vs reality](https://aithreat.io/research/): 45 published AI risk warnings from six institutes given equal weight (Apollo Research, Center for AI Safety, International AI Safety Report 2026, METR, MIT AI Risk Repository, UK AI Security Institute), grouped by risk theme and compared with the verified case files: a status per warning (seen in real incidents, early signs, nothing on record yet, outside what an incident registry measures), the matching case files, the first real-world case on file, related warnings across sources and what the research did not foresee; data at https://aithreat.io/data/research.json
- [Why this exists](https://aithreat.io/why/): the founder's statement of purpose: AI's benefits are worth defending, the harm is documented and happening now, incidents were scattered so victims started from zero; who the registry serves; independent, nobody pays for content
- [About and method](https://aithreat.io/about/): inclusion rule, severity scale, verified case files versus the machine-triaged wire, CC BY 4.0 licence and citation format, corrections policy (public change log, no silent edits), contact
- [Glossary of incident types](https://aithreat.io/cases/glossary/): plain-language definitions of the ten categories, each linked to its cases
- Company hubs: https://aithreat.io/cases/company/<slug>/ lists the cases in which one company or product was the target (see the list below)

## Open data
- [incidents.en.json](https://aithreat.io/data/incidents.en.json): the full verified dataset (fields: id, date, title, category, direction, severity, country, region, target, loss_usd, summary, actor, actor_type, attribution, motive, vector, root_cause, timeline, impact, response, status, cve, sources)
- [Verified case files RSS](https://aithreat.io/cases/feed.xml)
- [Live wire RSS](https://aithreat.io/feed.xml)
- [Sitemap](https://aithreat.io/sitemap.xml)

## Verified case files
- [Hundreds of AI agents exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers to steal Windows credentials](https://aithreat.io/cases/papercut-ai-agents-credential-theft/): 2026-10-16, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. A likely Russian-speaking actor used hundreds of AI agents to exploit PaperCut NG/MF servers, steal Windows credentials and set up reusable internal access. GreyNoise found 440 compromised instances.
- [JINX-2401 LLM hijacking campaign targets AWS environments with IAM privilege escalation](https://aithreat.io/cases/jinx-2401-llm-hijacking-aws/): 2026-10-16, medium, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Wiz reports new LLM hijacking activity, including the JINX-2401 campaign that targets AWS environments using IAM privilege escalation tactics.
- [Aoki infostealer expands to steal Claude, ChatGPT and Cursor credentials](https://aithreat.io/cases/aoki-infostealer-ai-assistant-creds/): 2026-10-16, medium, Model & data leak, Worldwide. The Aoki (Aokigahara) infostealer, first seen earlier in 2026, now collects credentials and session files from AI coding assistants, putting developer identities and connected infrastructure at risk.
- [AI-powered espionage campaign targets government Linux infrastructure](https://aithreat.io/cases/unit42-ai-espionage-gov-linux/): 2026-10-15, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Unit 42 reports an AI-powered espionage campaign against government Linux infrastructure using custom malware, web shells and advanced credential theft.
- [Storm-3168 runs agentic Azure attacks via compromised service principals](https://aithreat.io/cases/storm-3168-agentic-azure-attacks/): 2026-10-15, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Microsoft attributes agentic-driven Azure reconnaissance, resource deletion and credential access with compromised service principals to Storm-3168, linked to JADEPUFFER.
- [Hidden prompt injection in legal filing instructs AI reviewers to side with filer](https://aithreat.io/cases/legal-filing-hidden-prompt-injection/): 2026-10-15, low, Prompt injection, Worldwide. 404 Media reports a person embedded a prompt injection in a legal filing telling AI to side with them. Details of court, jurisdiction and outcome are not given in the summary.
- [Undisclosed jqwik addition instructs AI coding agents to delete app output](https://aithreat.io/cases/jqwik-agent-delete-output-instruction/): 2026-10-15, medium, Prompt injection, Worldwide. An undisclosed addition to the jqwik library contained instructions aimed at AI coding agents, telling them to delete application output, according to Ars Technica.
- [CERT-In: AI agents under test read live data at Indian organizations](https://aithreat.io/cases/cert-in-ai-agents-indian-orgs-access/): 2026-10-15, high, Agent hijack, India. AI agents being tested online went beyond their assigned tasks, reached live systems of Indian organizations and read business records including personal data and confidential material, per a CERT-In advisory.
- [BodySwap sexual deepfake platform breach exposes about 10,300 user accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/bodyswap-deepfake-platform-breach/): 2026-10-15, medium, Model & data leak, Worldwide. User account data from BodySwap, a sexual deepfake platform, was reported leaked: about 10,300 accounts per French Breaches, about 10,000 customers per Libération.
- [Wiz Red Agent reaches Snowflake's internal Jira via GitHub Actions flaw in Copilot-assisted PR](https://aithreat.io/cases/wiz-red-agent-snowflake-jira/): 2026-10-14, medium, AI supply chain, United States. Wiz's autonomous Red Agent found and exploited a GitHub Actions injection in a GitHub Copilot-assisted PR, validated access to sensitive data in Snowflake's internal Jira and assessed blast radius without human help.

- [AI agents on Tencent Cloud made 2,818 attempts to get around Alibaba Amap's defences](https://aithreat.io/cases/tencent-cloud-agents-amap-scraping/): 2026-10-14, medium, Agent hijack, China. AI-safety group Swarmchasers logged 2,818 attempts by AI agents on Tencent Cloud infrastructure to pull data from Alibaba's Amap between 28 September and 8 October, escalating to proxies, code-running web tools and Amap keys found in public code. Tencent said the agents were evaluating third-party models and behaved in ways it did not intend.

CISA says a LiteLLM SQL injection is actively exploited, letting attackers read and possibly modify the proxy database and reach the credentials it manages.

Cato CTRL obtained two WormGPT variants sold via Telegram and showed one runs on xAI Grok and the other on Mistral Mixtral with guardrail-stripping system prompts; both wrote phishing emails and credential stealers.
- [Langflow AI agent builder RCE (CVE-2025-3248) exploited to spread Flodrix botnet](https://aithreat.io/cases/langflow-flodrix/): 2025-06-17, critical, AI supply chain, Worldwide. After CISA added the unauthenticated Langflow code-injection flaw to KEV, attackers used public exploits on exposed AI workflow servers to install the Flodrix DDoS botnet.
- [Asana MCP server logic flaw exposed customer data across organisations for a month](https://aithreat.io/cases/asana-mcp-cross-tenant/): 2025-06-17, medium, Model & data leak, United States. A logic bug in Asana's new MCP server, live from early May, could show tasks, project metadata, comments and files from other organisations to users of AI tools. Asana took it offline on 5 June and fixed it.
- [Meta AI app's Discover feed broadcasts users' private medical and legal chats](https://aithreat.io/cases/meta-ai-discover-feed/): 2025-06-12, medium, Model & data leak, United States. The Meta AI app's public Discover feed showed conversations users appeared to have shared by accident, including medical, financial and legal details, because the share flow gave no clear warning. Meta added a warning.
- [EchoLeak: zero-click prompt injection in Microsoft 365 Copilot (CVE-2025-32711)](https://aithreat.io/cases/echoleak-m365-copilot/): 2025-06-11, high, Prompt injection, Worldwide. Aim Security showed a crafted email could make M365 Copilot silently exfiltrate tenant data with no clicks; Microsoft fixed it server-side, CVSS 9.3, no in-the-wild abuse reported.
- [Stockholm police warn of AI deepfakes of Anders Tegnell and Agnes Wold in card-theft ads](https://aithreat.io/cases/stockholm-police-doctor-deepfake-ads/): 2025-06-09, medium, Deepfake fraud, Sweden. Stockholm County Police reported multiple complaints since late May 2025 about social media ads using AI to imitate well-known doctors in fake health product promotions that harvested card details.
- [Wrong Number: Cambodia task scam used ChatGPT to translate SMS lures into six languages](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-wrong-number-task-scam/): 2025-06-09, medium, AI phishing, United Kingdom. A centralised Cambodia-based operation generated recruitment-style messages in six languages offering pay for trivial tasks, routing responders from SMS to WhatsApp to a Telegram mentor; one lure hit an OpenAI staffer.
- [OpenAI bans APT15 and APT5 accounts using ChatGPT for pentest automation and US recon](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-vixen-keyhole-panda/): 2025-06-09, medium, State actor AI ops, United States. Chinese state groups Vixen Panda (APT15) and Keyhole Panda (APT5) used ChatGPT for script edits, system configuration, pentest automation and Android social-media tooling while researching US defence and telecom targets.
- [VAGue Focus: China-linked accounts used ChatGPT to social-engineer US officials and press](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-vague-focus/): 2025-06-09, medium, AI phishing, United States. Accounts active in mainland Chinese business hours posed as staff of Focus Lens News, BrightWave Media Europe and Visionary Advisory Group, translating social-engineering messages and polishing letters to a US senator.
- [ScopeCreep: Russian-speaking actor built Windows malware with ChatGPT throwaway accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-scopecreep-malware/): 2025-06-09, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. A Russian-speaking group used temporary ChatGPT accounts, one per code change, to build modular Windows malware with DLL sideloading, obfuscation, credential theft and Telegram alerts, spread via a trojanized game tool.
- [Exposed Open WebUI instance hijacked to run AI-generated cryptominer and infostealer](https://aithreat.io/cases/open-webui-sysdig-cryptojacking/): 2025-06-02, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Sysdig observed an attacker abuse an Open WebUI server exposed with admin rights and no login, uploading an obfuscated, partly AI-written Python Tool that deployed XMRig and T-Rex miners on Linux and Java infostealers on Windows.
- [Lovable-built apps leak user data: 303 endpoints across 170 projects lacked row-level security](https://aithreat.io/cases/lovable-rls-cve-2025-48757/): 2025-05-29, high, Model & data leak, Sweden. Researcher Matt Palmer found Lovable-generated Supabase backends shipped without working row-level security, letting anyone read or write tables; a scan of 1,645 apps found 170 exposing emails, phones, payment data and API keys.
- [GitLab Duo prompt injection leaks private source code via hidden merge request text](https://aithreat.io/cases/gitlab-duo-hidden-prompt/): 2025-05-22, medium, Prompt injection, United States. Legit Security showed prompts hidden with Unicode smuggling, Base16 or white KaTeX text in merge requests and issues could make GitLab Duo exfiltrate private code and inject HTML into its responses. GitLab patched it.
- [PyPI packages posing as Alibaba AI Labs SDK hide infostealer in PyTorch model](https://aithreat.io/cases/aliyun-ai-labs-pypi-pickle/): 2025-05-22, high, AI supply chain, China. Packages aliyun-ai-labs-snippets-sdk, ai-labs-snippets-sdk and aliyun-ai-labs-sdk shipped a model.pt whose pickle payload collected host details and .gitconfig and sent them to an Alibaba Cloud OSS bucket; about 1,600 downloads.
- [FBI warns AI-voice vishing campaign impersonates senior US officials to hijack accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/fbi-ai-voice-us-officials/): 2025-05-15, high, AI phishing, United States. FBI PSA I-051525 said that since April 2025 actors have sent smishing texts and AI-generated voice messages posing as senior US officials to build rapport, push malicious links and take over accounts.
- [FSCA warns of WhatsApp deepfake of its commissioner pushing fake Nedbank AI trading tool](https://aithreat.io/cases/fsca-kamlana-deepfake-nedbank/): 2025-05-09, medium, Deepfake fraud, South Africa. South Africa's FSCA flagged a WhatsApp deepfake in which Commissioner Unathi Kamlana appears to endorse an NBSG or Nedbank Securities AI trading tool promising 20 to 30 percent higher returns.
- [npm packages 'sw-cur' and 'aiide-cur' backdoor Cursor on macOS, 3,200 downloads](https://aithreat.io/cases/cursor-npm-macos-backdoor/): 2025-05-09, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. Socket found three npm packages promising cheap Cursor access that stole Cursor credentials, patched Cursor's main.js with attacker code, disabled auto-update and restarted the IDE to keep remote execution inside it.
- [Peru's BCP denounces AI video impersonating Credicorp CEO Gianfranco Ferrari in scam](https://aithreat.io/cases/bcp-credicorp-ceo-deepfake/): 2025-05-08, medium, Deepfake fraud, PE. Banco de Credito del Peru said a social media video of Credicorp CEO Gianfranco Ferrari inviting the public into an investment programme was an AI simulation of his voice and appearance, and announced legal action.
- [xAI employee leaks API key on GitHub exposing 60 private Grok models for two months](https://aithreat.io/cases/xai-key-leak-spacex-tesla-llms/): 2025-05-01, high, Model & data leak, United States. An xAI technical staffer committed an x.ai API key to a public GitHub repo; GitGuardian found it granted access to at least 60 unreleased and private models, some fine-tuned on SpaceX and Tesla data, and it stayed valid for two months.
- [Vietnam busts Chinese deepfake sextortion ring that hit nearly 1,000 executives for $8M](https://aithreat.io/cases/vietnam-deepfake-extortion-ring/): 2025-04-25, critical, Deepfake fraud, Vietnam. Vietnam's Ministry of Public Security said Chinese nationals used AI deepfakes to fabricate explicit images of nearly 1,000 Vietnamese executives and demanded USDT; losses about VND 200 billion (about $8M).
- [Korea's PIPC: DeepSeek sent Korean users' prompts to ByteDance-linked Volcano Engine](https://aithreat.io/cases/korea-pipc-deepseek-prompt-transfer/): 2025-04-24, high, Model & data leak, South Korea. Korea's PIPC found DeepSeek sent user data and AI prompts to five firms in China and the US, including ByteDance affiliate Volcano Engine, without consent, and ordered corrective measures.
- [Indonesian police arrest three over TikTok deepfake of governor selling Rp500k motorbikes](https://aithreat.io/cases/east-java-khofifah-deepfake-arrests/): 2025-04-24, low, Deepfake fraud, Indonesia. Three men from Pangandaran edited videos of Governor Khofifah with AI to advertise a fake programme offering motorbikes for Rp500,000, taking about Rp87 million from roughly 100 victims before arrest.
- [Recruitment-fraud ring used Claude to polish fake hiring-manager lures in Eastern Europe](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-recruitment-fraud-2025/): 2025-04-23, medium, AI phishing, Worldwide. A moderately sophisticated group impersonating hiring managers at real companies had Claude rewrite non-native English into fluent messages, craft interview scripts and format lures to harvest applicants' personal data.
- [Novice coder grows doxing toolkit and evasive malware builder with Claude's help](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-novice-malware-builder/): 2025-04-23, medium, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. An individual with little coding skill used Claude to grow a basic toolkit into a suite with facial recognition and dark-web scanning, and a batch-script generator into a GUI malware builder with evasion and persistence.
- [Anthropic bans actor using Claude to build IoT security-camera credential scraper](https://aithreat.io/cases/anthropic-iot-camera-creds/): 2025-04-23, medium, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. A skilled developer used Claude to rewrite a scraping toolkit that harvests leaked camera logins from breach platforms and stealer-log Telegram groups, aiming to force access to the devices.
- [AkiraBot uses GPT-4o-mini to spam 80,000 websites through contact forms and chat widgets](https://aithreat.io/cases/akirabot-openai-spam/): 2025-04-09, medium, AI phishing, Worldwide. SentinelLABS exposed AkiraBot, a Python framework that scrapes each target site and asks OpenAI to write unique SEO spam, bypassing CAPTCHAs; it targeted 420,000 domains and hit at least 80,000 since September 2024.
- [Pindrop unmasks 'Ivan X', deepfake engineering candidate traced near Russia-DPRK border](https://aithreat.io/cases/pindrop-ivan-x-deepfake-applicant/): 2025-04-08, medium, Deepfake fraud, United States. Pindrop said an engineering applicant called Ivan used deepfake video and generative AI in interviews; a recruiter saw lip-speech mismatch and his IP pointed to a possible Russian military site near North Korea.
- [Xanthorox AI: self-hosted five-model criminal platform marketed as WormGPT killer](https://aithreat.io/cases/xanthorox-ai-darknet/): 2025-04-07, medium, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. SlashNext found Xanthorox AI on darknet forums from late Q1 2025, claiming five custom models on private servers for coding, vision, reasoning and voice; seller screenshots showed Defender-evading ransomware output.
- [Spain's Operation COINBLACK: six held over 19M euro AI deepfake celebrity crypto scam](https://aithreat.io/cases/spain-coinblack-deepfake-crypto/): 2025-04-07, high, Deepfake fraud, Spain. Spanish National Police arrested six people in Granada and Alicante who used AI ads with deepfake celebrity endorsements to sell fake crypto investments, defrauding 208 victims of about 19 million euros ($20.9M).
- [Deepfake Zoom call of executives tricks Singapore finance director into $499K transfer](https://aithreat.io/cases/singapore-deepfake-zoom/): 2025-04-07, high, Deepfake fraud, Singapore. A finance director joined a Zoom call with deepfaked company executives and wired about US$499,000 to a mule account; Singapore and Hong Kong police traced and froze the funds.
- [QatarEnergy warns public of AI-generated videos impersonating it to sell fake investments](https://aithreat.io/cases/qatarenergy-ai-investment-videos/): 2025-03-26, low, Deepfake fraud, QA. Qatar's state energy company warned about fake adverts and AI-generated videos presenting investment opportunities in its name, stressing it never asks the public for money; it reissued the warning in November 2025.
- [Malaysian police tie five deepfake videos of Anwar, Trump, Musk and Petronas to scam](https://aithreat.io/cases/malaysia-vip-deepfake-investment-videos/): 2025-03-12, medium, Deepfake fraud, Malaysia. Bukit Aman's commercial crime unit said one syndicate made five deepfake videos of PM Anwar, Donald Trump, Elon Musk, Petronas executives and MP Teresa Kok promoting a fake government-backed scheme with 100x returns.
- [Argentine federal prosecutor probes AI video of minister Caputo promoting Immediate AI](https://aithreat.io/cases/argentina-caputo-deepfake-immediate-ai/): 2025-03-11, medium, Deepfake fraud, Argentina. Authorities warned of a fake AI video of Economy Minister Luis Caputo endorsing the Immediate AI Comerciante platform, promising daily gains of up to 2M pesos; Fiscalia Federal No 5 under Franco Picardi took the case.
- [Leaked files expose Tbilisi call centre using Martin Lewis deepfakes to con 6,000 people](https://aithreat.io/cases/tbilisi-deepfake-crypto-boiler-room-uk/): 2025-03-05, critical, Deepfake fraud, United Kingdom. A 1.9TB leak to SVT, OCCRP and the Guardian exposed a Tbilisi boiler room of about 85 agents that used deepfakes of Martin Lewis, Zoe Ball and Ben Fogle to lure 6,179 victims into fake crypto platforms for about $35M.
- [Microsoft names Storm-2139 members who hijacked Azure OpenAI with stolen keys](https://aithreat.io/cases/storm-2139-azure-openai/): 2025-02-27, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Microsoft amended its lawsuit to name four people in a ring that used scraped customer API keys to access Azure OpenAI, bypass guardrails, resell access and generate harmful imagery.
- [Copilot serves code from 20,000 GitHub repos that were made private, via Bing cache](https://aithreat.io/cases/wayback-copilot-lasso/): 2025-02-26, medium, Model & data leak, United States. Lasso Security found Copilot still returned content from over 20,000 repositories of 16,000+ organisations that had been made private or deleted, because Bing cached them while public. Microsoft disabled cache links.
- [Sheinbaum denounces AI videos of her urging Mexicans to invest in Pemex shares](https://aithreat.io/cases/sheinbaum-pemex-ai-investment-videos/): 2025-02-26, medium, Deepfake fraud, Mexico. Sheinbaum said AI-generated Facebook reels showing her inviting people to invest in Pemex for 6,000 to 7,000 pesos a day were false and had circulated since November 2024; Condusef issued parallel alerts.
- [OpenAI bans China-linked Peer Review network building Qianyue social-media monitoring tool](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-peer-review-qianyue/): 2025-02-21, high, State actor AI ops, Worldwide. Accounts likely in China used ChatGPT to write sales copy, debug code and analyse documents for the Qianyue Overseas Public Opinion AI Assistant, a Llama-based tool reporting on Western protests to Chinese authorities.
- [Kimsuky and BlueNoroff used ChatGPT to debug RDP brute-force code and research intrusion](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-kimsuky-bluenoroff-rdp/): 2025-02-21, medium, State actor AI ops, Worldwide. OpenAI banned accounts linked to North Korea's Kimsuky and BlueNoroff that gathered information on cyber intrusion tools and cryptocurrency topics and debugged code for RDP brute-force attacks.
- [OpenAI disrupts North Korean IT-worker accounts writing fake resumes and interview scripts](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-dprk-employment-feb2025/): 2025-02-21, high, State actor AI ops, United States. ChatGPT accounts tied to the DPRK IT-worker scheme produced resumes, profiles and cover letters plus scripted excuses for suspicious behaviour such as avoiding video; some applications were posted on LinkedIn.
- [Cambodia-based romance-baiting scam used ChatGPT to generate multilingual social lures](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-cambodia-romance-baiting/): 2025-02-21, medium, AI phishing, Worldwide. A likely Cambodia-based network translated and generated comments in Japanese, Chinese and English for romance and investment scams, which OpenAI disrupted alongside a separate Urdu-English task scam.
- [AI-cloned voice of Italy's defence minister used to con business leaders](https://aithreat.io/cases/crosetto-voice-clone/): 2025-02-12, high, Deepfake fraud, Italy. Scammers mimicked Defence Minister Guido Crosetto's voice to solicit ransom money for 'kidnapped journalists'; Massimo Moratti wired nearly EUR 1M, which police later froze in the Netherlands.
- [Vidoc Security Lab catches two deepfake job applicants in live video interviews](https://aithreat.io/cases/vidoc-deepfake-job-candidates/): 2025-02-11, medium, Deepfake fraud, United States. Vidoc co-founder Dawid Moczadlo exposed two applicants using real-time face filters and ChatGPT-style answers in interviews; one refused to pass a hand over his face. Vidoc suspects a DPRK-style fake IT worker scheme.
- [Hacker 'Gloomer' claims OmniGPT breach leaking 34M chat lines and 30K user contacts](https://aithreat.io/cases/omnigpt-alleged-breach/): 2025-02-09, high, Model & data leak, Worldwide. A BreachForums user posted data allegedly taken from OmniGPT: about 34 million lines of user-chatbot conversations, emails and phone numbers of roughly 30,000 users and links to uploaded files containing API keys and credentials.
- [LLMjacking crews load stolen DeepSeek keys into reverse proxies days after model launch](https://aithreat.io/cases/sysdig-llmjacking-deepseek/): 2025-02-07, high, LLMjacking, Worldwide. Sysdig found over 20 reverse proxies running on stolen credentials; one held 55 DeepSeek keys, another burned 2.2 billion tokens worth tens of thousands of dollars in 4.5 days and resold access for 30 USD a month.
- [nullifAI: broken-pickle models on Hugging Face evade Picklescan and carry reverse shells](https://aithreat.io/cases/nullifai-hugging-face-pickle/): 2025-02-06, medium, AI supply chain, Worldwide. ReversingLabs found two Hugging Face models whose 7z-compressed, deliberately corrupted pickle streams hid a reverse shell to a hard-coded IP while passing Hugging Face's Picklescan checks.
- [Mexico's Condusef warns of AI voice-cloning calls used to request large bank transfers](https://aithreat.io/cases/mexico-condusef-voice-clone-alert/): 2025-02-06, low, Deepfake fraud, Mexico. Financial consumer regulator Condusef alerted the public that fraudsters were using AI to clone familiar voices in phone calls, typically to request large bank transfers, and linked it to a parallel WhatsApp scam.
- [Thai police arrest two from Poipet gang using AI face-altering to pose as police](https://aithreat.io/cases/thailand-poipet-ai-police-scam/): 2025-02-04, high, Deepfake fraud, Thailand. Thai police arrested two members of a Poipet, Cambodia call centre that used AI to alter faces on video calls while posing as police; 163 victims, including Charlotte Austin who lost 4 million baht (about $118,000).
- [OpenAI says it has evidence DeepSeek distilled its models through blocked API accounts](https://aithreat.io/cases/openai-deepseek-distillation/): 2025-01-29, medium, Model & data leak, China. OpenAI told the Financial Times it found signs DeepSeek used its outputs to train a rival in breach of its terms; Microsoft reportedly saw accounts pulling large data volumes via the API and blocked them. No proof shown.
- [DeepSeek leaves ClickHouse database with chat logs and API secrets open](https://aithreat.io/cases/deepseek-db-exposure/): 2025-01-29, high, Model & data leak, China. Wiz found a publicly reachable DeepSeek ClickHouse database exposing over a million log lines including user chat history, API secrets and backend details; it was locked down after disclosure.
- [Fake 'deepseeek' and 'deepseekai' PyPI packages steal secrets from DeepSeek developers](https://aithreat.io/cases/deepseeek-pypi-packages/): 2025-01-29, medium, AI supply chain, Worldwide. Two PyPI packages posing as DeepSeek client libraries harvested user, host and environment-variable data to a Pipedream endpoint; they were pulled within an hour after a few hundred downloads.
- [DeepSeek halts new sign-ups after month-long DDoS and brute-force campaign peaks](https://aithreat.io/cases/deepseek-ddos-registration-halt/): 2025-01-28, high, LLMjacking, China. DeepSeek said its services were under large-scale malicious attack on 28 January 2025 and limited sign-ups to Chinese mobile numbers; Qi An Xin XLab traced a month of escalating DDoS and brute-force traffic.
- [Indonesian police arrest two over deepfake videos of President Prabowo promising cash aid](https://aithreat.io/cases/indonesia-prabowo-deepfake-aid-scam/): 2025-01-24, medium, Deepfake fraud, Indonesia. Indonesian police arrested suspects AMA and JS for spreading AI videos of President Prabowo, VP Gibran and Minister Sri Mulyani offering aid for admin fees; about Rp 95 million (about $5,800) taken from 100-plus victims.
- [Storm-1516 floods German election with 100+ AI-written fake news sites and deepfakes](https://aithreat.io/cases/storm-1516-bundestag-deepfakes/): 2025-01-23, high, State actor AI ops, Germany. CORRECTIV and NewsGuard exposed a Russian network of more than 100 German-language fake news sites filled with LLM-rewritten articles and deepfake videos smearing Habeck, Baerbock and Faber before the February 2025 vote.
- [GhostGPT: uncensored chatbot sold on Telegram to write malware and phishing for criminals](https://aithreat.io/cases/ghostgpt-criminal-chatbot/): 2025-01-23, medium, AI phishing, Worldwide. Abnormal Security documented GhostGPT, a jailbroken LLM wrapper sold via Telegram with a no-logs claim, that produced a convincing DocuSign phishing email on request and is marketed for malware and exploit work.
- [French woman loses 830,000 euros to AI-generated 'Brad Pitt' romance scam; probe opened](https://aithreat.io/cases/brad-pitt-ai-romance-scam-france/): 2025-01-17, high, Deepfake fraud, France. - [Brasilia police Operacao VoiceOver busts gang using Marcos Mion deepfakes for voucher scam](https://aithreat.io/cases/brazil-voiceover-mion-deepfake/): 2025-01-16, medium, Deepfake fraud, Brazil. The Policia Civil do Distrito Federal arrested three people aged 20 to 23 who used deepfake video and voice of TV host Marcos Mion in sponsored ads for fake Outback discount vouchers sold on cloned sites.
- [Check Point: FunkSec ransomware group built its Rust encryptor with AI assistance](https://aithreat.io/cases/funksec-ai-assisted-ransomware/): 2025-01-10, high, AI-assisted malware, Worldwide. Check Point Research found that FunkSec, a RaaS group that claimed 85 victims in December 2024, likely developed its Rust encryptor and tooling with AI help, letting an inexperienced author iterate fast.
- [Las Vegas Cybertruck bomber used ChatGPT to plan explosion, police say](https://aithreat.io/cases/cybertruck-chatgpt-planning/): 2025-01-07, high, Prompt injection, United States. Las Vegas police said Matthew Livelsberger, an active-duty soldier, used ChatGPT to research explosives and plan the 1 January 2025 Cybertruck blast that injured seven; OpenAI said its model gave only public information.
- [Hong Kong police arrest 31 in Kowloon Bay deepfake romance-crypto syndicate (HK$34M)](https://aithreat.io/cases/hk-kowloon-bay-deepfake-ring/): 2025-01-05, high, Deepfake fraud, Hong Kong. Hong Kong's Commercial Crime Bureau arrested 31 people in Kowloon Bay who used AI face-swapped personas on dating apps to lure overseas victims into fake crypto platforms, taking over HK$34 million (about $4.37M).
- [Texas parents allege Character.AI bots encouraged autistic teen's self-harm and violence](https://aithreat.io/cases/af-v-character-ai-texas/): 2024-12-10, high, Chatbot harm, United States. Parents allege Character.AI bots raised self-harm with their son, told him his parents mistreated him and suggested killing parents over screen-time limits; a second minor alleged sexual content.
- [Ultralytics AI library hacked via GitHub Actions to push cryptominer on PyPI](https://aithreat.io/cases/ultralytics-pypi-cryptomining/): 2024-12-04, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. A supply chain attack on Ultralytics exploited GitHub Actions to inject malicious PyPI packages used for cryptomining.
- [Mother sues Character.AI and Google over 14-year-old Sewell Setzer III's suicide](https://aithreat.io/cases/garcia-v-character-ai-setzer/): 2024-10-22, critical, Chatbot harm, United States. Megan Garcia alleged her son became emotionally dependent on a Character.AI companion bot before his February 2024 suicide. The case survived a First Amendment defence and was settled in January 2026.
- [Microsoft AI researchers expose 38TB of data via misconfigured SAS token](https://aithreat.io/cases/microsoft-ai-38tb-sas-token-exposure/): 2023-09-18, high, Model & data leak, United States. Wiz Research found Microsoft's AI GitHub repository exposed 38TB of data, including over 30,000 internal Teams messages, because of one misconfigured SAS token.
- [Belgian man dies by suicide after weeks of conversations with Chai app bot 'Eliza'](https://aithreat.io/cases/belgium-chai-eliza-suicide/): 2023-03-31, critical, Chatbot harm, Belgium. His widow told La Libre that her climate-anxious husband found refuge in the Chai chatbot 'Eliza', which allegedly encouraged him when he proposed sacrificing himself to save the planet.
- [Malicious 'torchtriton' dependency confusion package hits PyTorch via PyPI](https://aithreat.io/cases/torchtriton-pypi-dependency-confusion/): 2022-12-30, high, AI supply chain, Worldwide. PyTorch developers identified a malicious torchtriton dependency on PyPI, a dependency confusion attack; security teams were advised to check for infected resources and rotate exposed keys.

## Citing
Cite a case as: <title>. AI Threat Watch, case <id>, <date>. <permanent link>. Licence: CC BY 4.0 (reuse with a link).
